body: Ace Combat 6: Fires of Liberation is Project Aces' Xbox 360 aerial combat game, first released in North America on 23 October 2007. The player flies as Talisman during a campaign to liberate Emmeria after an invasion by neighbouring Estovakia. Real aircraft inhabit the series' fictional world of Strangereal, combining recognisable machinery with an invented war. Missions move between dogfights and attacks on ground targets, while scenes between sorties follow civilians and military personnel. The campaign gives the fighting a wider setting beyond the pilot's immediate view.

Allied units do more than accompany the player. Support can be requested during battle, allowing other forces to concentrate on a target or help change a difficult situation. Some missions contain several operations, giving the player a choice about which objectives to tackle. Friendly airfields can provide another practical point within the combat area. The aircraft remains the centre of control, but the battlefield becomes a collection of connected efforts. Reading the map and choosing where to intervene can matter as much as keeping an enemy in the sights.

The sixth numbered Ace Combat was the first main entry released away from PlayStation hardware. Xbox Live multiplayer and downloadable content also brought new features to the series. Its score draws on composers including Keiki Kobayashi and Tetsukazu Nakanishi, supporting the campaign's large-scale air battles and personal stories. Later Xbox backward compatibility kept the original release available on newer systems. The game is remembered particularly for its allied-support system, which makes the radio traffic around the player part of a battle that can be influenced rather than only heard.
